responsibility: Implements GCC’s tree-level SCC and RPO value-numbering engines for GIMPLE SSA, including memory value numbering. It maintains hash tables for n-ary expressions, PHIs, constants, and reference operations, computes value numbers through SCC-based optimistic processing or RPO iteration, performs expression simplification and equivalence lookup, supports PRE/FRE and other passes with availability tracking, and provides the elimination logic for full redundancy removal driven by VN results.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for tree SSA value numbering: it contains the SCC/RPO VN algorithms, hash-table logic, memory/reference VN, elimination routines, and the FRE pass driver. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-sccvn.h only defines the VN data structures and exposes the APIs and hooks those algorithms use.
